name: Nemeton Lantern (Item Glow)
author: Nocturne
description: Adds a razor-tight, painter's-order additive shimmer and subtle rim glow directly on 3D room pickups so hidden items stand out clearly in Nemeton Monastery without bloating past the item silhouette. Press * (or your chosen hotkey) in-game to toggle.

settings.label: Glow Strength
settings.description: How bright the pulsing halo appears around pickup sparkles

settings.label: Lantern Color
settings.description: Color palette of the lantern aura and corner status pill

settings.label: Toggle Hotkey
settings.description: In-game key to toggle the lantern on/off (* avoids Co-op F6)

settings.label: Show Corner Status Pill
settings.description: Display the LANTERN indicator pill in the corner of the screen
